summary: Frontend-only Stage C retest completed on local OpenNext workerd (http://127.0.0.1:8787). Responsive overflow and nav-system rules pass at 1440/1101/1100/1024/768/430/390/360, but a P0 regression remains: at 430/390/360 the comparison tray + WhatsApp + phone overlap the visible cookie consent banner. No MOCKED APIs were used.

ui_bugs.component: Floating actions + comparison tray + cookie banner
ui_bugs.issue: At 430/390/360, visible consent banner vertically overlaps comparison tray and both floating buttons, causing tap-target collision in bottom-right area.

integration_issues.flow: Small-screen utility controls with consent visible
integration_issues.issue: Fixed-position offsets are not consent-aware; when consent appears, controls remain anchored to viewport bottom and collide with the banner.

action_items: Add consent-aware bottom offsets (or a shared stacking system) for comparison tray and floating action buttons so they sit above cookie banner on 430/390/360.
Re-run Stage C responsive retest at 430/390/360 with compare item present and consent visible to verify no overlap.
Keep current desktop/mobile nav breakpoint behavior (desktop >1100, mobile at <=1100) as it now validates correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: styles.css has overlapping legacy breakpoints (1023/768/430) plus new Stage C breakpoints (1100/640), increasing regression risk for future responsive edits.
Root cause of P0: fixed controls use static bottom values and do not adapt when cookie banner appears; this creates deterministic overlap at small widths.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all requested checks passed except mobile consent/controls overlap at 430/390/360)

seed_data_creation: Set localStorage brightluxx_compare_products to one test product during UI validation; no backend seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: no horizontal overflow at tested widths; exactly one nav system visible as required; desktop mega menu, mobile menu, hero CTA links, WhatsApp/phone hrefs, cookie accept flow, raw SEO, and no hydration errors reproduced. Remaining blocker is small-screen bottom overlay collision when consent banner is visible and comparison tray is present.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: (1) set viewport 430/390/360, (2) set localStorage brightluxx_compare_products with one item, (3) remove brightluxx_cookie_consent, (4) reload and wait for consent banner. Observed overlap matrix shows tray_cc=true, wa_cc=true, ph_cc=true. Mitigation: coordinate fixed-bottom elements via CSS custom property or class toggled by consent visibility, then recompute bottom offsets for tray/phone/WhatsApp.
